theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (H : Rn n → E), Integrable H → MemLp H 2 volume → ∀ (ρ : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ j, Continuous (ρ j)) → (∀ j z, 0 ≤ ρ j z) → (∀ j, ∫ z, ρ j z = 1) → (∀ j z, ε j ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ j z = 0) → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖(∫ z, ρ j z • H (x - z)) - H x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)
